svg.text: Chief engineer's day room: the desk and the maintenance computer · JS5-511 · revision 0 · 12 November 2026

Officers' deck, port side, under the wheelhouse. Drawn before it is built. Nothing else stands in the suite yet: its bedroom and wet unit are not partitioned off. The arrangement is the owner's package's (CE-SUITE-GA-001, MS-CE-001); the measures are this room's.
Forward is up; port is to the left. Chief engineer's suite: 4.50 m across, 5.95 m fore and aft, 2.8 m deck to deck
kept for the settee and the bedroom's partition
HER SIDE, AS ONE SITS AT THE DESK
Looking to port: forward is to the right, the after wall to the left. Heights over the deck.
Looking aft: port is to the right. The desk, the screen and the chair are seen from their after end.
the two cables end in this box, marked
· The owner's method statement for the suite (MS-CE-001) gives it a distribution board of its own,
DB-CE, by the door, and the day room's sockets its circuit S1: a 16 A breaker, 3 x 2.5 mm², in
skirting trunking, the back boxes 0.30 m over the deck.
· Built so: the twin socket (7) and the data outlet (8) on her side under the desk; 5.0 m of
skirting trunking (9) from them aft along her side, inboard along the after wall and up beside
· DB-CE IS NOT INSTALLED. Its place (10) is an outline and a sign; both cables end in the box
under it and say so. The board that is to feed it does not exist aboard yet: the register enters
its feeder from the lighting and small-power board.
· The computer draws 180 W with its screen (typical for a desk computer; not a maker's figure). No
network is built aboard: the maintenance program keeps its records on the computer and needs
· A tap on the computer (3, 4, 5 or 6) sits one down at it: Maintenance Desk, a Johansson Co
program, fills the page, inside the Chisum's own page.
· One button, top left, always in sight: "Back to the Chisum". Escape does the same. One stands
· The program holds every item aboard from the ship's own lists, with its jobs, its records, and
the yard's drawings and instructions that are about it.
· "Show on board" on an item puts the program away and brings the thing up aboard. A fitting's
card aboard offers "Maintenance", which opens the program at that fitting.
· The rest of the suite: the bedroom, the wet unit, the linings, the settee, a lamp over the desk.
The chair does not turn. Nothing lies on the desk but the computer.
· The distribution board DB-CE, the board that is to feed it, and any network: the cables end at
· The keys carry no letters. The calendar's picture was made with an image service from a
description; its month is drawn from the calendar itself.
Along her side at the room's after end, 0.25 m from the after wall
1.60 by 0.75 m, 0.74 m high: two end panels, a back panel, 3 drawers at its forward end. Its forward 0.50 m is under the window, 0.31 m under the sill
Before the desk, inboard of it
On a five-star base with castors. Whoever sits in it faces her side: the window at the right hand, the calendar at the left
On the desk on its stand, 0.20 m clear of the window's edge
54 by 31 cm. While nobody sits at it, it shows the program's opening picture. Its two cables go down behind its stand and the desk
On the desk, before the screen
Its cable goes along the back of the desk's top, over its edge and down her side to the system unit
On its mat, at the right hand
On the deck under the desk's after end
180 W with its screen (typical, not a maker's). 0.84 m for the knees. Its cables pass under the desk's back panel and are clipped to her side
On her side under the desk, 0.30 m up
Circuit S1 of DB-CE: 16 A, 3 x 2.5 mm², in the skirting trunking (MS-CE-001). The computer and its screen are plugged into it
Its cable goes in the same trunking to the same box. No network cabinet is installed. The program needs no network
Her side and the after wall, and up beside the door
5.0 m, 60 by 20 mm, with a riser to each outlet. It carries the socket's cable and the data cable
On the after wall, 0.12 m to port of the doorway, 1.48 m up
NOT INSTALLED: a yellow outline and a sign. THE TWO CABLES END IN THE BOX UNDER IT, and say so
On the after wall, 1.18 to 1.78 m up, left of whoever sits
42 by 60 cm on a nail, wire-bound across its middle: the month's picture above, the month below, today ringed
